experiences.question: State the race and year of race in which Michael Schumacher had his fastest lap.
experiences.sql:
SELECT races.name, races.year
FROM races
JOIN results ON races.raceId = results.raceId
JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId
WHERE drivers.forename = 'Michael' AND drivers.surname = 'Schumacher'
ORDER BY results.fastestLapTime ASC
LIMIT 1

experiences.question: For the driver who set the fastest lap speed, what is his nationality?
experiences.sql: SELECT d.nationality FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId ORDER BY r.fastestLapSpeed DESC LIMIT 1;

experiences.question: State all the tags used by Mark Meckes in his posts that doesn't have comments.
experiences.sql:
WITH filtered_posts AS (
SELECT p.Tags
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.Id = c.PostId
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes' AND c.PostId IS NULL
),
split(tag, rest) AS (
SELECT
CASE WHEN INSTR(Tags, '>') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(Tags, 2, INSTR(Tags, '>') - 2) ELSE Tags END,
CASE WHEN INSTR(Tags, '>') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(Tags, INSTR(Tags, '>') + 1) ELSE '' END
FROM filtered_posts
WHERE Tags IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
CASE WHEN INSTR(rest, '>') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(rest, 2, INSTR(rest, '>') - 2) ELSE rest END,
CASE WHEN INSTR(rest, '>') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(rest, INSTR(rest, '>') + 1) ELSE '' END
FROM split
WHERE rest <> ''
)
SELECT DISTINCT tag FROM split WHERE tag <> '';

experiences.question: Please provide top four football players' IDs who are among the lowest potential players and prefer to use the right foot when attacking.
experiences.sql:
SELECT P.id
FROM (
  SELECT player_api_id, potential
  FROM (
    SELECT player_api_id, potential, preferred_foot,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE preferred_foot = 'right' AND potential IS NOT NULL
  ) t
  WHERE rn = 1
) sub
JOIN Player P ON sub.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
ORDER BY sub.potential ASC
LIMIT 4;

experiences.question: List out the account numbers of female clients who are oldest and has lowest average salary, calculate the gap between this lowest average salary with the highest average salary?
experiences.sql:
WITH oldest_female AS (
    SELECT client_id, district_id, birth_date
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F' AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
),
salary_stats AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.A10) AS min_salary, MAX(d.A10) AS max_salary
    FROM oldest_female of
    JOIN district d ON of.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT a.account_id, (s.max_salary - s.min_salary) AS gap
FROM oldest_female of
JOIN disp ON of.client_id = disp.client_id

What is the first name, country code, and birth date of the player with the most winner rank points across all matches?

SELECT first_name, country_code, birth_date
FROM players
WHERE player_id = (
    SELECT player_id
    FROM (
        SELECT p.player_id, SUM(m.winner_rank_points) AS total_points
        FROM players p
        JOIN matches m ON p.first_name || ' ' || p.last_name = m.winner_name
        GROUP BY p.player_id
        ORDER BY total_points DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
)

experiences.question: What is the code of airport that has the highest number of flights?
experiences.sql:
SELECT AirportCode
FROM (
    SELECT DestAirport AS AirportCode, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM flights
    GROUP BY DestAirport
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SourceAirport AS AirportCode, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM flights
    GROUP BY SourceAirport
)
GROUP BY AirportCode
ORDER BY SUM(cnt) DESC
LIMIT 1

experiences.question: What are the ids and names of all countries that either have more than 3 car makers or produce fiat model ?
experiences.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.CountryId, c.CountryName
FROM countries c
WHERE c.CountryId IN (
    SELECT cm.Country
    FROM car_makers cm
    GROUP BY cm.Country
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
)
OR c.CountryId IN (
    SELECT cm.Country
    FROM car_makers cm
    JOIN model_list ml ON cm.Id = ml.Maker
    JOIN car_names cn ON ml.Model = cn.Model
    WHERE cn.Make = 'fiat'
)

experiences.question: What are the id and names of the countries which have more than 3 car makers or produce the 'fiat' model?
experiences.sql:
SELECT T1.CountryId, T1.CountryName
FROM countries AS T1
JOIN car_makers AS T2 ON T1.CountryId = T2.Country
GROUP BY T1.CountryId, T1.CountryName
HAVING COUNT(T2.Id) > 3
UNION
SELECT T1.CountryId, T1.CountryName
FROM countries AS T1
JOIN car_makers AS T2 ON T1.CountryId = T2.Country
JOIN model_list AS T3 ON T2.Id = T3.Maker
WHERE T3.Model = 'fiat'

experiences.question: State all the tags used by Mark Meckes in his posts that doesn't have comments.
experiences.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE filtered AS (
    SELECT Id, Tags
    FROM posts
    WHERE OwnerDisplayName = 'Mark Meckes'
      AND COALESCE(CommentCount, 0) = 0
      AND Tags IS NOT NULL
      AND Tags <> ''
),
split AS (
    SELECT Id, '' AS tag, REPLACE(REPLACE(Tags, '<', ''), '>', ',') AS rest
    FROM filtered
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Id,
           SUBSTR(rest, 1, INSTR(rest, ',') - 1),
           SUBSTR(rest, INSTR(rest, ',') + 1)
    FROM split
    WHERE rest != ''
)
SELECT DISTINCT tag
FROM split
WHERE tag <> '';

experiences.question: List out the account numbers of female clients who are oldest and has lowest average salary, calculate the gap between this lowest average salary with the highest average salary?
experiences.sql:
SELECT a.account_id AS account_number,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district WHERE A11 IS NOT NULL) - mc.A11 AS gap
FROM (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id, d.A11
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'female'
      AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'female')
      AND d.A11 IS NOT NULL
      AND d.A11 = (
          SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
          FROM district d2
          JOIN client c2 ON d2.district_id = c2.district_id
          WHERE c2.gender = 'female'
            AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'female')
            AND d2.A11 IS NOT NULL
      )
) mc
JOIN disp ON mc.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id;

experiences.question: find the names of museums which have more staff than the minimum staff number of all museums opened after 2010.
experiences.sql:
SELECT Name
FROM museum
WHERE Num_of_Staff > (

)

experiences.question: find the id, name and age for visitors who visited some museums more than once.

FROM visitor v

GROUP BY v.ID, v.Name, v.Age
HAVING COUNT(vi.Museum_ID) > 1

JOIN visit AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.visitor_ID
GROUP BY T1.ID
ORDER BY SUM(T2.Total_spent) DESC
LIMIT 1

LIMIT 1

experiences.question: What are the name of the countries where there is not a single car maker?

experiences.question: Which are the car makers which produce at least 2 models and more than 3 car makers ? List the id and the maker .
experiences.sql:
SELECT T1.Id, T1.Maker
FROM car_makers AS T1
JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.Maker
GROUP BY T1.Id, T1.Maker
HAVING COUNT(T2.ModelId) >= 2 AND COUNT(T2.ModelId) > 3

experiences.question: What are the id and names of the countries which have more than 3 car makers or produce the 'fiat' model?
experiences.sql:
SELECT T1.CountryId, T1.CountryName
FROM countries AS T1
JOIN car_makers AS T2 ON T1.CountryId = T2.Country
GROUP BY T1.CountryId, T1.CountryName
HAVING COUNT(T2.Id) > 3
UNION
SELECT T1.CountryId, T1.CountryName
FROM countries AS T1
JOIN car_makers AS T2 ON T1.CountryId = T2.Country
JOIN model_list AS T3 ON T2.Id = T3.Maker
WHERE T3.Model = 'fiat'

experiences.question: For the client whose loan was approved first in 1993/7/5, what is the increase rate of his/her account balance from 1993/3/22 to 1998/12/27?
experiences.sql:
WITH target_loan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
start_balance AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_loan)
      AND date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
end_balance AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_loan)
      AND date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ROUND(((end_balance.balance - start_balance.balance) * 100.0 / start_balance.balance), 2) AS increase_rate
FROM start_balance, end_balance;

experiences.question: Which makers designed more than 3 car models? List full name and the id.

experiences.question: For the cars with 4 cylinders, which model has the largest horsepower?

experiences.question: Among the cars with more than lowest horsepower, which ones do not have more than 3 cylinders? List the car makeid and make name.
experiences.sql:
SELECT T1.MakeId, T1.Make
FROM car_names AS T1
WHERE T1.MakeId IN (
    SELECT Id FROM cars_data
    WHERE Horsepower > (SELECT MIN(Horsepower) FROM cars_data)
)
AND T1.MakeId NOT IN (
    SELECT Id FROM cars_data
    WHERE Cylinders > 3
)

experiences.question: Among the cars that do not have the minimum horsepower , what are the make ids and names of all those with less than 4 cylinders ?

FROM car_names T1 
JOIN cars_data T2 ON T1.MakeId = T2.Id 
WHERE T2.Horsepower > (SELECT MIN(Horsepower) FROM cars_data) 
AND T2.Cylinders < 4

experiences.question: Which are the car makers which produce at least 2 models and more than 3 car makers ? List the id and the maker .
experiences.sql:
SELECT T1.Id, T1.Maker
FROM car_makers AS T1
JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.Maker
GROUP BY T1.Id, T1.Maker
HAVING COUNT(T2.ModelId) >= 2 AND COUNT(T2.ModelId) > 3

experiences.question: What are the id and names of the countries which have more than 3 car makers or produce the 'fiat' model?
experiences.sql:
SELECT T1.CountryId, T1.CountryName
FROM countries AS T1
JOIN car_makers AS T2 ON T1.CountryId = T2.Country
GROUP BY T1.CountryId, T1.CountryName
HAVING COUNT(T2.Id) > 3
UNION
SELECT T1.CountryId, T1.CountryName
FROM countries AS T1
JOIN car_makers AS T2 ON T1.CountryId = T2.Country
JOIN model_list AS T3 ON T2.Id = T3.Maker
WHERE T3.Model = 'fiat'

experiences.question: Give the name of the nation that uses the greatest amount of languages.
experiences.sql: SELECT Name FROM country JOIN countrylanguage ON country.Code = countrylanguage.CountryCode GROUP BY Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

experiences.question: Which continent has the most diverse languages?
experiences.sql:
SELECT Continent FROM country 
JOIN countrylanguage ON country.Code = countrylanguage.CountryCode 
GROUP BY Continent 
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT Language) DESC 
LIMIT 1

experiences.question: Which continent speaks the most languages?
experiences.sql:
SELECT Continent, COUNT(DISTINCT Language) AS LanguageCount
FROM country
JOIN countrylanguage ON country.Code = countrylanguage.CountryCode
GROUP BY Continent
ORDER BY LanguageCount DESC
LIMIT 1

experiences.question: What are the names of nations where both English and French are official languages?
experiences.sql:
SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Code IN (
    SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'English' AND IsOfficial = 'T'
    INTERSECT
    SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'French' AND IsOfficial = 'T'
)

experiences.question: Give the names of countries with English and French as official languages.
experiences.sql:
SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Code IN (
    SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'English' AND IsOfficial = 'T'
    INTERSECT
    SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'French' AND IsOfficial = 'T'
)

experiences.question: What is the number of distinct continents where Chinese is spoken?
experiences.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.Continent)
FROM country AS T1
JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode
WHERE T2.Language = 'Chinese'

experiences.question: What is the language that is used by the largest number of Asian nations?
experiences.sql:
SELECT T1.Language
FROM countrylanguage AS T1
JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Code
WHERE T2.Continent = 'Asia'
GROUP BY T1.Language
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T2.Code) DESC
LIMIT 1

experiences.question: Which languages are spoken by only one country in republic governments?
experiences.sql:
SELECT T1.Language
FROM countrylanguage AS T1
JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Code
WHERE T2.GovernmentForm = 'Republic'
GROUP BY T1.Language
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CountryCode) = 1

experiences.question: What languages are only used by a single country with a republic government?
experiences.sql:
SELECT T1.Language
FROM countrylanguage AS T1
JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Code
WHERE T2.GovernmentForm = 'Republic'
GROUP BY T1.Language
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CountryCode) = 1

experiences.question: What is the most populace city that speaks English?

FROM city
WHERE city.CountryCode IN (
    SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'English'
)
ORDER BY city.Population DESC
LIMIT 1

experiences.question: Find the average age of the dogs who went through treatments.
experiences.sql:
SELECT AVG(CAST(age AS INTEGER)) 
FROM Dogs 
WHERE dog_id IN (SELECT dog_id FROM Treatments)

experiences.question: Which professionals live in the state of Indiana or have done treatment on more than 2 treatments? List his or her id, last name and cell phone.
experiences.sql:
SELECT T1.professional_id, T1.last_name, T1.home_phone
FROM Professionals T1
LEFT JOIN Treatments T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id
WHERE T1.state = 'Indiana'
GROUP BY T1.professional_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.treatment_id) > 2 OR T1.state = 'Indiana'

experiences.question: Find the id, last name and cell phone of the professionals who live in the state of Indiana or have performed more than two treatments.
experiences.sql:
SELECT T1.professional_id, T1.last_name, T1.home_phone
FROM Professionals AS T1
LEFT JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id
WHERE T1.state = 'Indiana'
GROUP BY T1.professional_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.treatment_id) > 2
UNION
SELECT professional_id, last_name, home_phone
FROM Professionals
WHERE state = 'Indiana'

experiences.question: Tell me the owner id and last name of the owner who spent the most on treatments of his or her dogs.

ORDER BY SUM(T1.cost_of_treatment) ASC

HAVING COUNT(T2.treatment_id) > 2 OR T1.state = 'Indiana'

WHERE T1.state = 'Indiana'

HAVING COUNT(T2.treatment_id) > 2

SELECT professional_id, last_name, home_phone
FROM Professionals
WHERE state = 'Indiana'

experiences.question: Which professionals live in the state of Indiana or have done treatment on more than 2 treatments? List his or her id, last name and cell phone.

SELECT T1.professional_id, T1.last_name, T1.home_phone
FROM Professionals T1
LEFT JOIN Treatments T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id
WHERE T1.state = 'Indiana'
GROUP BY T1.professional_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.treatment_id) > 2 OR T1.state = 'Indiana'

experiences.question: Find the id, last name and cell phone of the professionals who live in the state of Indiana or have performed more than two treatments.

FROM Professionals AS T1
LEFT JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id
WHERE T1.state = 'Indiana'
GROUP BY T1.professional_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.treatment_id) > 2
UNION
SELECT professional_id, last_name, home_phone
FROM Professionals
WHERE state = 'Indiana'

experiences.question: Lists all types of cards in German.
experiences.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(value) AS type
FROM (
    SELECT value
    FROM cards
    JOIN foreign_data ON cards.uuid = foreign_data.uuid
    WHERE foreign_data.language = 'German'
    CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(cards.subtypes, ',')
    UNION
    SELECT value
    FROM cards
    JOIN foreign_data ON cards.uuid = foreign_data.uuid
    WHERE foreign_data.language = 'German'
    CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(cards.supertypes, ',')
) AS all_types
WHERE TRIM(value) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(value) != '';

experiences.question: For the client whose loan was approved first in 1993/7/5, what is the increase rate of his/her account balance from 1993/3/22 to 1998/12/27?
experiences.sql:
WITH target_account AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05' AND l.status = 'A'
    AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    ORDER BY l.date, l.loan_id
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    ((SELECT balance FROM trans WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_account) AND date = '1998-12-27') - 
     (SELECT balance FROM trans WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_account) AND date = '1993-03-22')) / 
    (SELECT balance FROM trans WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_account) AND date = '1993-03-22') * 100 AS increase_rate;

experiences.question: What are the opening year and staff number of the museum named Plaza Museum?
experiences.sql: SELECT Open_Year, Num_of_Staff FROM museum WHERE Name = 'Plaza Museum'

experiences.question: find the names of museums which have more staff than the minimum staff number of all museums opened after 2010.
experiences.sql:
SELECT Name
FROM museum
WHERE Num_of_Staff > (
    SELECT MIN(Num_of_Staff)
    FROM museum
    WHERE CAST(Open_Year AS INTEGER) > 2010
)

experiences.question: find the id, name and age for visitors who visited some museums more than once.
experiences.sql:
SELECT v.ID, v.Name, v.Age
FROM visitor v
JOIN visit vi ON v.ID = vi.visitor_ID
GROUP BY v.ID, v.Name, v.Age
HAVING COUNT(vi.Museum_ID) > 1

experiences.question: What are the id, name and membership level of visitors who have spent the largest amount of money in total in all museum tickets?
experiences.sql:
SELECT T1.ID, T1.Name, T1.Level_of_membership
FROM visitor AS T1
JOIN visit AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.visitor_ID
GROUP BY T1.ID
ORDER BY SUM(T2.Total_spent) DESC
LIMIT 1

experiences.question: What are the id and name of the museum visited most times?

FROM museum AS T1
JOIN visit AS T2 ON T1.Museum_ID = T2.Museum_ID
GROUP BY T1.Museum_ID
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

experiences.question: For the drivers who took part in the race in 1983/7/16, what's their race completion rate?
experiences.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN results.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS completion_rate
FROM races
INNER JOIN results ON races.raceId = results.raceId
INNER JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId
INNER JOIN status ON results.statusId = status.statusId
WHERE races.date = '1983-07-16'

experiences.question: What are the name of the countries where there is not a single car maker?

EXCEPT

experiences.question: Which are the car makers which produce at least 2 models and more than 3 car makers ? List the id and the maker .
experiences.sql:
SELECT T1.Id, T1.Maker
FROM car_makers AS T1
JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.Maker
GROUP BY T1.Id, T1.Maker
HAVING COUNT(T2.ModelId) >= 2 AND COUNT(T2.ModelId) > 3

experiences.question: What are the id and names of the countries which have more than 3 car makers or produce the 'fiat' model?
experiences.sql:
SELECT T1.CountryId, T1.CountryName
FROM countries AS T1
JOIN car_makers AS T2 ON T1.CountryId = T2.Country
GROUP BY T1.CountryId, T1.CountryName
HAVING COUNT(T2.Id) > 3
UNION
SELECT T1.CountryId, T1.CountryName
FROM countries AS T1
JOIN car_makers AS T2 ON T1.CountryId = T2.Country
JOIN model_list AS T3 ON T2.Id = T3.Maker
WHERE T3.Model = 'fiat'

experiences.question: For the cars with 4 cylinders, which model has the largest horsepower?
experiences.sql:
SELECT T2.Model 
FROM cars_data AS T1 
JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.ModelId 
WHERE T1.Cylinders = 4 
ORDER BY T1.Horsepower DESC 
LIMIT 1

experiences.question: For all of the 4 cylinder cars, which model has the most horsepower?

FROM model_list AS T1

WHERE T2.Cylinders = 4 
ORDER BY CAST(T2.Horsepower AS INTEGER) DESC 
LIMIT 1

experiences.question: Among the cars with more than lowest horsepower, which ones do not have more than 3 cylinders? List the car makeid and make name.
experiences.sql:
SELECT T1.MakeId, T1.Make
FROM car_names AS T1
WHERE T1.MakeId IN (
    SELECT Id FROM cars_data
    WHERE Horsepower > (SELECT MIN(Horsepower) FROM cars_data)
)
AND T1.MakeId NOT IN (
    SELECT Id FROM cars_data
    WHERE Cylinders > 3
)

experiences.question: Among the cars that do not have the minimum horsepower , what are the make ids and names of all those with less than 4 cylinders ?

SELECT T1.MakeId, T1.Make 
FROM car_names T1 
JOIN cars_data T2 ON T1.MakeId = T2.Id 
WHERE T2.Horsepower > (SELECT MIN(Horsepower) FROM cars_data) 
AND T2.Cylinders < 4

experiences.question: Which are the car makers which produce at least 2 models and more than 3 car makers ? List the id and the maker .
experiences.sql:
SELECT T1.Id, T1.Maker
FROM car_makers AS T1
JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.Maker
GROUP BY T1.Id, T1.Maker
HAVING COUNT(T2.ModelId) >= 2 AND COUNT(T2.ModelId) > 3

experiences.question: What are the id and names of the countries which have more than 3 car makers or produce the 'fiat' model?
experiences.sql:
SELECT T1.CountryId, T1.CountryName
FROM countries AS T1
JOIN car_makers AS T2 ON T1.CountryId = T2.Country
GROUP BY T1.CountryId, T1.CountryName
HAVING COUNT(T2.Id) > 3
UNION
SELECT T1.CountryId, T1.CountryName
FROM countries AS T1
JOIN car_makers AS T2 ON T1.CountryId = T2.Country
JOIN model_list AS T3 ON T2.Id = T3.Maker
WHERE T3.Model = 'fiat'

experiences.question: Which professionals live in the state of Indiana or have done treatment on more than 2 treatments? List his or her id, last name and cell phone.
experiences.sql:
SELECT T1.professional_id, T1.last_name, T1.home_phone
FROM Professionals T1
LEFT JOIN Treatments T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id
WHERE T1.state = 'Indiana'
GROUP BY T1.professional_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.treatment_id) > 2 OR T1.state = 'Indiana'

experiences.question: Find the id, last name and cell phone of the professionals who live in the state of Indiana or have performed more than two treatments.

FROM Professionals AS T1
LEFT JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id
WHERE T1.state = 'Indiana'
GROUP BY T1.professional_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.treatment_id) > 2
UNION
SELECT professional_id, last_name, home_phone
FROM Professionals
WHERE state = 'Indiana'

FROM Dogs

experiences.question: Which professionals live in the state of Indiana or have done treatment on more than 2 treatments? List his or her id, last name and cell phone.
experiences.sql:
SELECT T1.professional_id, T1.last_name, T1.home_phone
FROM Professionals T1
LEFT JOIN Treatments T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id
WHERE T1.state = 'Indiana'
GROUP BY T1.professional_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.treatment_id) > 2 OR T1.state = 'Indiana'

experiences.question: Find the id, last name and cell phone of the professionals who live in the state of Indiana or have performed more than two treatments.
experiences.sql:
SELECT T1.professional_id, T1.last_name, T1.home_phone
FROM Professionals AS T1
LEFT JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id
WHERE T1.state = 'Indiana'
GROUP BY T1.professional_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.treatment_id) > 2
UNION
SELECT professional_id, last_name, home_phone
FROM Professionals
WHERE state = 'Indiana'

experiences.question: Are there more in-patient or outpatient who were male? What is the deviation in percentage?
experiences.sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(IIF(Admission = '+', 1, 0)) AS in_patient,
    SUM(IIF(Admission = '-', 1, 0)) AS out_patient,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(IIF(Admission = '-', 1, 0)) > 0 THEN 
            CAST(SUM(IIF(Admission = '+', 1, 0)) AS REAL) / SUM(IIF(Admission = '-', 1, 0)) * 100 
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS deviation_percent
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

experiences.question: List all the frame styles and cards Allen Williams worked on and find any banned cards if there are any.
experiences.sql:
SELECT cards.frameVersion AS frame_style,
       cards.name AS card_name,
       CASE WHEN MAX(legalities.status) = 'Banned' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_banned
FROM cards
LEFT JOIN legalities ON cards.uuid = legalities.uuid
WHERE cards.artist = 'Allen Williams'
GROUP BY cards.id, cards.frameVersion, cards.name
ORDER BY card_name;

experiences.question: Among the cars with more than lowest horsepower, which ones do not have more than 3 cylinders? List the car makeid and make name.

FROM car_names AS T1
WHERE T1.MakeId IN (

AND T1.MakeId NOT IN (

    WHERE Cylinders > 3
)

experiences.question: What are the id and names of the countries which have more than 3 car makers or produce the 'fiat' model?

JOIN model_list AS T3 ON T2.Id = T3.Maker

experiences.question: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?
experiences.sql:
WITH customer_annual AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_annual
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg_min AS (
    SELECT ca.Segment, AVG(ca.total_consumption) AS avg_min_consumption
    FROM customer_annual ca
    JOIN segment_min sm ON ca.Segment = sm.Segment AND ca.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ca.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_min_consumption FROM segment_avg_min WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT avg_min_consumption FROM segment_avg_min WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_min_consumption FROM segment_avg_min WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT avg_min_consumption FROM segment_avg_min WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_min_consumption FROM segment_avg_min WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT avg_min_consumption FROM segment_avg_min WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

experiences.question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?
experiences.sql:
WITH consumption_by_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    INNER JOIN customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
growth AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        consumption_2013 - consumption_2012 AS increase,
        CASE 
            WHEN consumption_2013 = 0 THEN NULL 
            ELSE (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2013 
        END AS pct_increase
    FROM consumption_by_segment
)
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT Segment, pct_increase, 'biggest' AS type 
    FROM growth 
    ORDER BY pct_increase DESC 
    LIMIT 1
) AS t1
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT Segment, pct_increase, 'lowest' AS type 
    FROM growth 
    ORDER BY pct_increase ASC 
    LIMIT 1
) AS t2;

experiences.question: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?
experiences.sql:
WITH 
customers_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, y.Consumption
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
),
totals AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment, SUM(Consumption) AS total_cons
    FROM customers_2013
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
min_per_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_cons) AS min_cons
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, t.CustomerID, t.total_cons
    FROM totals t
    INNER JOIN min_per_seg m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_cons = m.min_cons
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_cons) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_cons
    FROM lowest_customers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_cons END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_cons END) AS SME_LAM_diff,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_cons END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_cons END) AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_cons END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_cons END) AS KAM_SME_diff
FROM seg_avg;
